reviews.body:
Thank you for contribution! 

Please address the comments and 
add test to verify that user client string always in the format: 

```
<app_name>/<app_version> <client_name>/<client_version> (<comment>; <key1>: <value1>; <key2>: <value2>)
```

Not parentheses in the middle (this is our format across all clients to make things clear) 

Thanks!

review_comments.body:
this will produce repeating parentheses like: 
```
my-analytics-app jdbc-v2/0.12.0-rc1-SNAPSHOT ((apache.spark))
clickhouse-java-v2/0.12.0-rc1-SNAPSHOT (env:staging; region:us-east-1; ...)
``` 
This is not a format we want to keep across all clients. Here is one correct: 
```
<app_name>/<app_version> <client_name>/<client_version> (<comment>; <key1>: <value1>; <key2>: <value2>)
```

please move to ConnectionImpl tests. We do no create standalone unit tests like this. 
generally we do prefer integration tests because unit tests verify only half of the logic.
